_comment: Per-level conversion spec. Holds ONLY our own choices and indexes into the user's disc (string ordinals in DATA/chars.bum, stream indexes in banks, segment numbers in main.mus) - never Frontline text or data. The converter resolves them on the player's PC and writes the result into the generated pk3 only.

1_1.place: Pointe Saint-Mathieu (St. Mathieu), Finistere, Brittany, France
1_1._place_source: disc: briefing journal 1_1_bLog.viv page j1_1_pg1 header 'SEASIDE STOWAWAY / St. Mathieu, France / 17 August 1944 - 0900 Hours'; location table chars.bum @0x2bd0 (= shell.viv @0x10a36d0). Real place: Pointe Saint-Mathieu lighthouse/abbey near Brest - matches the dock dialogue about docking near the lighthouse. No St. Nazaire / St. Malo / Periers strings on the disc; the 'Periers 7 km' road sign is level-only dressing art, not the setting. Levels 1_3/1_4 = 'Shipyards of Lorient, France'. Chrono: before AA M5 (20 Aug 1944, Brest).
